description: Cryptocurrency prices, market data and rankings from CoinMarketCap, with its own indices (Fear and Greed, Altcoin Season, CMC20 and CMC100), coin categories and profiles, price conversion, and prices and safety checks for tokens on decentralized exchanges. No account or API key required; a free API key is optional and gives the connection a rate limit of its own.
